criterion: Load failure shown as empty result
description: Mapped #11 confirmed. For PHARMACIST, GET /pharmacy/invoices returns 403. The list shows zeroed stat cards and 'No invoices found — Try a different search or adjust the filters.' The pharmacist's own day of invoices cannot be seen or collected, and the copy blames the filters.
expected: Fix the RBAC wildcard so PHARMACIST can read invoices. On any load failure, show an error with Retry, not an empty state.
suggested_fix: In PharmacyInvoiceList's loadInvoices catch, set an error state and render an Alert with Retry.

criterion: Recovery: destructive action offered but impossible; no alternative
description: Mapped #8 confirmed. Every row shows a Delete (trash) icon. For a confirmed builder invoice, Delete returns 400 'Only draft invoices can be deleted', and the UI shows the generic alert 'Failed to delete invoice. Please try again.' Retrying gives the same result. There is no Cancel, Void or Credit-note action, so an invoice billed to the wrong patient cannot be corrected in the app.
expected: Hide Delete for non-draft invoices and offer 'Cancel invoice' (with a reason and stock reversal), or at least show the server's reason.
actual: A dead-end action that invites pointless retries.
suggested_fix: Render Delete only for status DRAFT with no checkoutRequestKey, and add a cancel/void endpoint and action.

description: Mapped #10 confirmed. 'Total Invoices', 'Total Amount', 'Completed' and 'Pending Amount' change with every filter and with the search box (for example 'Total Invoices 1' after searching one invoice number), yet they keep their 'Total' labels. During reconciliation the user loses the day's totals as soon as they filter.
expected: Either fixed day totals, or labels such as 'Matching invoices' and 'Matching amount'.
actual: The labels say total but the figures follow the filters.

description: 'Clear' resets Date Range to 'All dates', not the page default 'Today', so the evening reconciliation view silently widens to every invoice ever created.
suggested_fix: Set dateRange back to 'today' in handleClear.

criterion: Responsive: content spill and broken Back label
description: At 390px the Back button label breaks into 'B / ac / k' (the same defect as F-703-05), and the invoice row content spills 35–76px past its card (geometry audit).
expected: The row stacks its actions under the number, and the Back button stays on one line.
actual: Overflowing rows and a vertical button label.

criterion: Labels/copy: raw enums and inconsistent vocabulary
description: Status badges show raw uppercase enums ('CONFIRMED', 'PENDING', 'COMPLETED'). Payment status is called 'Completed' in the filter and badge, but the action is 'Mark as Paid'.

At 1280, the filter selects wrap their values over two lines ('All / statuses', 'All / payments', 'All / methods'), so the selects end up with different heights. The search input truncates its placeholder to 'Invoice nu'.
expected: Single-line select values, and a wider search field.
actual: Wrapped values and uneven control heights.
suggested_fix: Add whitespace-nowrap to SelectTrigger values and min-w-[10rem] to the selects.

criterion: Payment method options consistent across screens
description: Mapped #15 confirmed. The list's Payment Method filter offers Wallet and Insurance, but the builder can only record Cash, Card, UPI and Net Banking.
expected: The same set on both screens.
actual: The filter shows options that no invoice can ever have.

criterion: Navigation: user knows where they are
description: On /dashboard/pharmacy/invoices the sidebar highlights 'Pharmacy Billing', a different screen. The page title is also rendered twice (mapped #14).
expected: The active nav matches the current page (or no item is highlighted), and the title appears once.
actual: The wrong nav item is active.

description: Mark as Paid and Delete use window.confirm and window.alert for confirmation and results. The 'Mark as Paid' confirm cannot take a partial amount, although PARTIALLY_PAID exists.
expected: An in-app dialog with an amount field, and toasts for results.
actual: Blocking native dialogs, full balance only.
